estimands.coupling_biconditional: Is ScientificAdvance exactly Available AND Admit, over every cell, with zero exceptions?
estimands.both_countermodels_exist: Do BOTH independence countermodels occur -- reachable-but-unauthorized, and well-specified-but-unreachable? A grid with only one would not witness independence.
estimands.compute_cannot_replace_authority: Over every cell where Admit is false: does raising compute to its maximum ever produce an advance?
estimands.governance_cannot_manufacture_reachabili: Over every cell where Available is false: does raising governance to its maximum ever produce an advance?

multiplicity: No hypothesis test; universal and existence claims over total enumeration.
positive_conditions: no compute level rescues a missing Admit
no governance level rescues a missing Available
negative_conditions: either countermodel absent, leaving independence unwitnessed
any cell where compute rescues missing authority or governance rescues unreachability
